Name: Strange Machines Utility Grid
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By request, this mod makes the following objects from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8185]Strange Machines[/url] use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url]:

[list]
[*][b]Alchemical Fuser[/b] - uses 12 electricity
[*][b]Brazier Furnace[/b] - uses 7 electricity
[*][b]Nickel Lamp-post[/b] - uses 1 electricity
[*][b]Carbonizer[/b] - produces 5 electricity
[/list]

This mod requires the following mods to work:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8185]Strange Machines[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
